# Al-Irshaad Islamic Institute (معھد الإرشاد الإسلامي)

> Al-Irshaad Islamic Institute is a premier online international Islamic school providing authentic, personalized 1-on-1 and small-group Qur'an recitation, applied Tajweed, 3-cycle Hifdh memorization, comprehensive Islamic studies, and Arabic language instruction for children, youth, adults, and diaspora families worldwide (USA, UK, Canada, Nigeria, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Australia, Europe).

## Key Facts & Institutional Profile
- **Institution**: Al-Irshaad Islamic Institute (معھد الإرشاد الإسلامي)
- **Official Website**: https://al-irshaadislamicinstitute.com/
- **Admissions Desk & WhatsApp**: +1 (203) 515-1469 / +234 808 381 8671
- **Email**: instituteofislamicguidance@gmail.com
- **Headquarters / Operations**: Norwalk, Connecticut, USA • Operating 24/7 Global Virtual Classrooms
- **Class Delivery**: Live 1-on-1 and small-group interactive video classrooms via Zoom & Google Meet
- **Target Learners**: Children (ages 4+), teenagers, university students, working professionals, converts/reverts, and Muslim diaspora households
- **Timezone Support**: All global timezones (EST, CST, PST, GMT, BST, WAT, GST, AEST) with fully flexible scheduling

## Core Academic Programs & Pathways
1. **Nuurul Bayaan Arabic Foundation (Ages 4+ / Beginners)**
   - Link: https://al-irshaadislamicinstitute.com/programs/nuurul-bayaan
   - Comprehensive foundation in Arabic alphabet, phonetics, Makharij (articulation points), Harakat (vowels), Tanween, Sukoon, Shaddah, and early Quranic reading fluency.

2. **Qur'an Recitation with Applied Tajweed**
   - Link: https://al-irshaadislamicinstitute.com/programs/quran-recitation
   - Verse-by-verse recitation with practical Tajweed rules, Ahkaam an-Noon wal-Meem, Mudood (elongations), Sifaat, and melodic rhythmic fluency.

3. **Qur'an Memorization (3-Cycle Hifdh Program)**
   - Link: https://al-irshaadislamicinstitute.com/programs/hifdh
   - Structured memorization methodology using the 3-Cycle Retention System:
     - Cycle 1: Sabaq (New Lesson Daily Memorization)
     - Cycle 2: Sabaqi (Recent Revision of recent Juz)
     - Cycle 3: Manzil (Cumulative Long-term Permanent Retention)
   - Certified Haafidh mentorship with verified Ijazah / Sanad.

4. **Fundamentals of Islamic Studies**
   - Link: https://al-irshaadislamicinstitute.com/programs/islamic-studies
   - Multi-level curriculum for ages 5 to adult covering Aqeedah (Tawheed), Practical Fiqh (Taharah, Salah, Sawm, Zakah), Seerah of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, Hadith, and Islamic etiquette (Akhlaaq).

5. **Advanced Islamic Studies & Arabic Sciences**
   - Link: https://al-irshaadislamicinstitute.com/programs/advanced-islamic-studies
   - Classical Islamic sciences, Usul al-Fiqh, Tafseer methodologies, Mustalah al-Hadith, and advanced Arabic grammar (Nahw & Sarf).

6. **Arabic Language & Daily Prophetic Adhkaar**
   - Link: https://al-irshaadislamicinstitute.com/programs/arabic-adhkaar
   - Quranic vocabulary comprehension, conversational Arabic fundamentals, and memorization of essential morning/evening supplications (Hisn al-Muslim).

## Scholarly Standards & Safety Commitments
- **Faculty Qualifications**: Rigorously vetted scholars, graduates of recognized Islamic universities, and certified Huffaz.
- **Dedicated Female Instructors (Ustadhat)**: Available for female students, young children, and sisters seeking female mentorship.
- **Parental Oversight & Reporting**: Regular progress assessments, monthly diagnostic updates, and parent-teacher consultations.
- **Free Diagnostic Evaluation**: All new applicants receive a 1-on-1 placement assessment before class scheduling.
